mainTopic: Degrees of טומאה in תרומה and קודש according to רבי יוסי and רבי עקיבא, whether צירוף by a vessel is Torah or rabbinic, and רבי עקיבא's rule that there is no טומאת ידים in the מקדש
overview: Background: the levels of טומאה are ראשון, שני, שלישי, רביעי. Normally, חולין can become up to a שני, תרומה up to a שלישי, and קודש up to a רביעי. The amud opens by finishing a point from earlier on the daf: שלישי בקודש comes straight from a פסוק, and רבי יוסי's קל וחומר is needed only for רביעי בקודש. The גמרא then proves that רבי יוסי does not hold like רבי עקיבא, who says חולין can become a שלישי. If he did, his logic would also give רביעי בתרומה and חמישי בקודש. Next the גמרא asks the reverse: how do we know רבי עקיבא does not accept רבי יוסי's קל וחומר? An argument from silence is offered and rejected. Then a real proof is found: a משנה about a vessel joining its contents (צירוף) stops at רביעי for קודש and שלישי for תרומה, and רבי יוחנן traces that משנה to רבי עקיבא's testimony. Along the way the גמרא notes a מחלוקת: רבי יוחנן holds צירוף is דרבנן, while רבי חנין derives it from the Torah through 'כף אחת'. Finally the גמרא quotes a משנה about a needle found in sacrificial meat, from which רבי עקיבא learns that there is no טומאת ידים in the מקדש.

steps.title: A verse shows that holy meat can become a third-level impurity
steps.stepSummary: The end of the פסוק 'והבשר אשר יגע בכל טמא לא יאכל' covers meat that touched a שני. That means קודש can become a שלישי straight from the Torah.
steps.simpleTranslation: '...any impure thing shall not be eaten.' Aren't we dealing even with a case where the meat touched a second-level impurity?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes quoting a פסוק about holy meat that touched something impure. It points out that the פסוק includes even meat that touched a שני.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק says 'כל טמא', meaning anything impure. That wording includes something that is only a שני. Meat of קודש that touches a שני becomes a שלישי, so שלישי בקודש comes directly from the Torah and needs no קל וחומר.

keyTerms.meaning: Any impure thing (wording from the פסוק)
Aren't we dealing with...? (a rhetorical 'surely this case is included')

steps.confusionAlert: This amud begins in the middle of a פסוק. The full verse is 'והבשר אשר יגע בכל טמא לא יאכל' (ויקרא ז:יט).

phrases.english: "...any impure thing shall not be eaten"
phrases.notes: End of ויקרא ז:יט, which begins 'And the meat that touches...'

phrases.english: Are we not dealing even with where it touched a second-level impurity?
phrases.notes: So the meat becomes a third-level impurity.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the earlier discussion of where שלישי בקודש comes from.
steps.raayaObject: That קודש can become a שלישי
steps.raayaSupportSource: ויקרא ז:יט, 'והבשר אשר יגע בכל טמא לא יאכל'

steps.title: Only the fourth level needs the logical derivation
steps.stepSummary: Since שלישי בקודש comes from the פסוק, רבי יוסי's קל וחומר is needed only for רביעי בקודש.
steps.simpleTranslation: The fourth level is learned through the קל וחומר, as we said.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא wraps up the point. The פסוק gives us the third level for holy things, and the קל וחומר gives us the fourth.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each level now has its own source. The פסוק covers שלישי בקודש. רבי יוסי's קל וחומר covers רביעי בקודש: if a מחוסר כפורים, who may eat תרומה, still disqualifies קודש, then a שלישי, which disqualifies תרומה, should surely create a רביעי in קודש.

keyTerms.meaning: An 'all the more so' argument, from a lighter case to a stricter one

steps.whatToRemember: שלישי בקודש comes from a פסוק. רביעי בקודש comes from רבי יוסי's קל וחומר.

phrases.english: The fourth level is from the a fortiori argument, as we stated.
phrases.notes: Refers back to רבי יוסי's קל וחומר from מחוסר כפורים.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Draws the conclusion from step 1: the קל וחומר is needed only for the fourth level.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The פסוק teaches שלישי בקודש, and the קל וחומר teaches רביעי בקודש.

steps.title: Proof that רבי יוסי does not hold like רבי עקיבא
steps.stepSummary: Suppose רבי יוסי agreed with רבי עקיבא that חולין can become a שלישי. Then his own קל וחומר would force him to add a level to each: רביעי בתרומה and חמישי בקודש. He never says this, so he must disagree with רבי עקיבא.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if you think he holds like רבי עקיבא, let him also teach: a fourth level for תרומה and a fifth level for holy things.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא returns to an earlier question: does רבי יוסי agree with רבי עקיבא? It proves he does not, because he never teaches the extra levels that would follow.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי עקיבא holds שלישי בחולין. If רבי יוסי accepted that, his 'one level higher' logic would move everything up by one. תרומה would reach רביעי and קודש would reach חמישי. Since רבי יוסי stops at רביעי בקודש, he must not accept שלישי בחולין.

keyTerms.meaning: And if it enters your mind (if you were to think)
The portion of produce given to a כהן

steps.whyThisMatters: This shows that רבי יוסי's system stops at רביעי בקודש. It does not include רבי עקיבא's extra level for חולין.

phrases.aramaic: וְאִי סָלְקָא דַעְתָּךְ סָבַר כְּרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא,
phrases.english: And if it enters your mind that he holds like Rabbi Akiva,
phrases.notes: 'He' is רבי יוסי. רבי עקיבא holds that חולין can become a third-level impurity.

phrases.english: let him also teach:
a fourth level for teruma and a fifth level for consecrated items.
phrases.notes: These would follow from the same קל וחומר.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאִי סָלְקָא דַעְתָּךְ סָבַר כְּרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After settling the sources for each level, the גמרא returns to whether רבי יוסי agrees with רבי עקיבא.
steps.raayaObject: That רבי יוסי does not hold שלישי בחולין
steps.raayaSupportSource: רבי יוסי's silence: he never teaches רביעי בתרומה or חמישי בקודש

steps.title: How do we know רבי עקיבא does not hold like רבי יוסי?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks the reverse question. Maybe רבי עקיבא accepts רבי יוסי's קל וחומר, which together with his own שלישי בחולין would give רביעי בתרומה and חמישי בקודש.
steps.simpleTranslation: But that רבי עקיבא does not hold like רבי יוסי — from where do we know this?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא now flips the question. We showed רבי יוסי disagrees with רבי עקיבא, but how do we know רבי עקיבא disagrees with רבי יוסי? This sets up the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רבי יוסי we had proof from his silence. For רבי עקיבא there is no such proof yet. He might accept the קל וחומר and end up with a five-level system for קודש.

phrases.english: But Rabbi Akiva —
that he does not hold like Rabbi Yosei, from where do we know?

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶלָּא רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא לָא סָבַר כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי מְנָלַן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Mirrors step 3, asking the same question about the other תנא.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: A source showing that רבי עקיבא rejects רבי יוסי's קל וחומר

steps.title: No תנא ever quotes רבי עקיבא as holding a fifth level
steps.stepSummary: The answer: if רבי עקיבא held רביעי בתרומה and חמישי בקודש, some תנא would surely have taught it in his name. None did.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: Because it would be impossible for no תנא to come along, teach 'a fourth level for תרומה and a fifth for holy things,' and say 'this is רבי עקיבא's view.'
steps.whatsHappening: An answer is given (per the Sefaria translation, רב כהנא speaking to רב אשי). It is an argument from silence: such an unusual ruling would have been recorded somewhere.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A five-level system for קודש would be a striking חידוש. If רבי עקיבא held it, we would expect at least one ברייתא to quote it in his name. Since none does, we conclude he does not accept רבי יוסי's קל וחומר.

keyTerms.meaning: To slip by, to be avoided
A teacher of ברייתות; a sage of the משנה period

phrases.english: He said to him:
phrases.notes: רב כהנא is speaking to רב אשי.

phrases.english: For a tanna would not have failed
phrases.notes: Literally: it would not slip by that a תנא would not...

phrases.english: to teach a fourth level for teruma and a fifth level for consecrated items,
and to say: this is the view of Rabbi Akiva.

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: No תנא teaches רביעי בתרומה and חמישי בקודש in רבי עקיבא's name, so he must not hold it.

steps.title: Can we really rely on an argument from silence?
steps.stepSummary: The answer is challenged in disbelief: should we build a conclusion just on the fact that no תנא happened to say it?
steps.simpleTranslation: And on this we should stand up and rely?!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא rejects the argument from silence. It doubts that the absence of a ברייתא is enough proof.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The answer in step 5 rested only on what was missing, not on a positive source. The response asks whether it is reasonable to base a ruling about רבי עקיבא's view on that alone. It weakens the proof without offering another one.
steps.whatToRemember: We have proof that רבי יוסי rejects רבי עקיבא's שלישי בחולין. The reverse claim, that רבי עקיבא rejects רבי יוסי's קל וחומר, is here supported only by an argument from silence, and that argument is rejected. The next steps (7–9) bring a real proof from a משנה based on רבי עקיבא's testimony.
steps.confusionAlert: This is not a new question. It is a disbelieving reaction that rejects the previous answer as too weak.

phrases.english: And we, on this,
should stand up and rely?!
phrases.notes: This is said in disbelief, as if to ask: could that really be?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the argument-from-silence answer of step 5.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The proof that רבי עקיבא does not accept רבי יוסי's קל וחומר
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The proof depends only on the absence of a recorded ברייתא, which is not strong enough to rely on.

steps.title: A משנה that lists the levels of impurity
steps.stepSummary: רב אשי (or רב כהנא) goes out and finds a משנה: a vessel joins its contents for קודש but not for תרומה, and רביעי is פסול in קודש while שלישי is פסול in תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אשי (some say רב כהנא) went out, looked carefully, and found what we learned in a משנה: A vessel joins together whatever is inside it for קודש, but not for תרומה. A רביעי is פסול for קודש, and a שלישי is פסול for תרומה.
steps.whatsHappening: Instead of relying on the fact that no תנא said it, a real source is brought. This משנה sets the limits of טומאה for קודש and for תרומה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה says קודש goes down to a רביעי and תרומה goes down to a שלישי. It says nothing about a חמישי בקודש or a רביעי בתרומה. If this משנה follows רבי עקיבא, then we have a clear proof about his view.

keyTerms.meaning: The vessel joins its contents into one unit, so if one part becomes טמא, all of it does
A fourth level of טומאה, which applies to holy items
A third level of טומאה, which applies to תרומה

steps.confusionAlert: This משנה alone does not yet prove anything about רבי עקיבא. The next step connects the משנה to him.

phrases.english: Rav Ashi went out,
and some say it was Rav Kahana,
examined carefully and found
that which we learned in a Mishnah:

phrases.aramaic: הַכְּלִי מְצָרֵף אֶת מַה שֶּׁבְּתוֹכוֹ לַקּוֹדֶשׁ,
phrases.english: A vessel joins whatever is inside it for consecrated items,
but not for terumah.
And the fourth level is disqualified in consecrated items,
and the third level in terumah.
phrases.notes: No level beyond these is listed.

steps.triggerLanguage: נְפַק רַב אָשֵׁי, וְאִי תֵּימָא רַב כָּהֲנָא, דַּק וְאַשְׁכַּח
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of Step 6 by bringing an actual source instead of relying on silence.
steps.raayaObject: That רבי עקיבא does not hold of רביעי בתרומה or חמישי בקודש
steps.raayaSupportSource: The משנה listing רביעי for קודש and שלישי for תרומה

steps.title: This משנה comes from רבי עקיבא's testimony
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן says the משנה comes from רבי עקיבא's testimony that a טבול יום who touches part of the flour, incense, frankincense, or coals in a vessel makes all of it פסול.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי חייא בר אבא said in the name of רבי יוחנן: This משנה was taught based on רבי עקיבא's testimony. As a ברייתא teaches: רבי עקיבא added the fine flour, the incense, the frankincense, and the coals. If a טבול יום touched part of them, he made all of them פסול.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא shows that the משנה from Step 7 is really רבי עקיבא's view. This is the link that turns the משנה into proof about רבי עקיבא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי עקיבא testified that a vessel joins its contents, even items like frankincense and coals. רבי יוחנן says the משנה about צירוף and the levels of טומאה is based on this testimony. So the levels the משנה lists, and the limits it sets, belong to רבי עקיבא.

keyTerms.meaning: Testimony of a חכם about a received הלכה, collected in מסכת עדיות
A person who immersed today but must wait until nightfall to be fully טהור. He makes קודש and תרומה פסול.
Touching part of them disqualifies all of them

phrases.english: And Rabbi Chiya bar Abba said
that Rabbi Yochanan said:
From the testimony of Rabbi Akiva
this Mishnah was taught.
(As it was taught in a baraita:)
Rabbi Akiva added
the fine flour and the incense
and the frankincense and the coals,
that if a tevul yom touched part of them
he disqualified all of them.
phrases.notes: The vessel joins them into one unit.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאָמַר רַבִּי חִיָּיא בַּר אַבָּא אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: מֵעֵדוּתוֹ שֶׁל רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא נִשְׁנֵית מִשְׁנָה זוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attributes the משנה of Step 7 to רבי עקיבא.
steps.raayaObject: That the משנה reflects רבי עקיבא's view
steps.raayaSupportSource: רבי יוחנן's statement and the ברייתא of רבי עקיבא's testimony

steps.title: Fourth yes, fifth no; third yes, fourth no
steps.stepSummary: Since the משנה is רבי עקיבא's, he holds רביעי בקודש but not חמישי, and שלישי בתרומה but not רביעי.
steps.simpleTranslation: A fourth level in קודש: yes. A fifth: no. A third level in תרומה: yes. A fourth: no.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא draws the conclusion. רבי עקיבא does not add an extra level to קודש or תרומה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This fully answers the question from Step 4. Even though רבי עקיבא holds שלישי בחולין, he does not accept רבי יוסי's קל וחומר in a way that would push up to רביעי בתרומה and חמישי בקודש. The proof now rests on a real משנה, not on silence.
steps.whatToRemember: רבי עקיבא: קודש stops at רביעי and תרומה stops at שלישי. There is no חמישי בקודש and no רביעי בתרומה.

phrases.english: A fourth level, yes; a fifth, no.
A third level, yes; a fourth, no.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Draws the conclusion from the משנה now attributed to רבי עקיבא.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: רבי עקיבא does not hold רביעי בתרומה or חמישי בקודש.

steps.title: רבי יוחנן holds joining by a vessel is rabbinic
steps.stepSummary: From רבי יוחנן's statement, the גמרא infers that he holds צירוף is only דרבנן.
steps.simpleTranslation: This shows that he (רבי יוחנן) holds: joining by a vessel is a rabbinic law.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא turns to a side point it learns from רבי יוחנן's words. It is setting up a contrast with another אמורא in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Frankincense and coals are not food, so their טומאה is only דרבנן. רבי יוחנן based the משנה's rule of צירוף on רבי עקיבא's testimony about these items. That means he sees צירוף as a rabbinic rule.

keyTerms.meaning: Joining separate items into one unit for טומאה

phrases.english: Apparently he holds:
joining by a vessel is rabbinic.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Draws a side inference from רבי יוחנן's statement in Step 8.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי יוחנן, צירוף כלי is דרבנן.

steps.title: רבי חנין derives joining from a verse
steps.stepSummary: This disagrees with רבי חנין, who says צירוף is דאורייתא because the פסוק calls all the incense in the spoon "one."
steps.simpleTranslation: And this disagrees with רבי חנין, who said: Joining is from the Torah, as it says: "One spoon of ten gold shekels, full of incense." The פסוק treated everything in the spoon as one.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא notes that רבי יוחנן's view conflicts with רבי חנין. רבי חנין brings a Torah source for צירוף.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק in the offerings of the נשיאים calls a spoon full of many pieces of incense "one" spoon full of incense. רבי חנין learns that a vessel makes its contents one unit by Torah law. So the two אמוראים disagree: רבי יוחנן says צירוף is דרבנן, and רבי חנין says it is דאורייתא.
steps.whatToRemember: There is a מחלוקת: רבי יוחנן holds צירוף is דרבנן, and רבי חנין holds it is דאורייתא, learned from "כף אחת."

phrases.english: And this disagrees with Rabbi Chanin,
who said: joining is by Torah law,
as it is said: "One spoon of ten gold shekels
full of incense,"

phrases.aramaic: הַכָּתוּב עָשָׂה כׇּל מַה שֶּׁבַּכַּף אַחַת.
phrases.english: the verse treated everything in the spoon as one.

steps.triggerLanguage: וּפְלִיגָא דְּרַבִּי חָנִין, דְּאָמַר: צֵירוּף דְּאוֹרָיְיתָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Contrasts רבי יוחנן's view from Step 10 with רבי חנין's opposing view.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי חנין, צירוף כלי is דאורייתא, learned from "כף אחת ... מלאה קטרת."

steps.title: The case of the needle found in the meat
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes a משנה. If a needle is found in the meat of a קרבן, the knife and the hands stay pure, but the meat is impure. If it is found in the stomach waste (פרש), everything is pure.
steps.simpleTranslation: We learned in a משנה elsewhere: about a needle that was found in the meat, the ruling is that the knife and the hands are pure, but the meat is impure. If the needle was found in the stomach waste, everything is pure.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves to a new but related source about purity in the מקדש. It quotes a משנה about a needle found inside sacrificial meat, which sets up רבי עקיבא's comment in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The needle may have been impure, so the meat it was stuck in becomes impure. Strangely, the knife and the hands that touched the needle stay pure, and the גמרא will soon explore why. When the needle sits in the stomach waste (פרש), nothing becomes impure, because פרש is not food and does not pass on טומאה.

keyTerms.meaning: 'We learned there.' This introduces a משנה from another place in ש״ס.
A needle. Here, a metal vessel that may have been impure.
Undigested waste in the animal's stomach. It is not considered food.

steps.confusionAlert: Do not think the meat is impure because the hands made it impure. The hands are pure. The meat is impure because of the needle itself.

phrases.english: We learned there (in a Mishnah):
phrases.notes: This brings in a משנה from somewhere else, because it also deals with purity in the מקדש.

phrases.english: About a needle that was found in the meat,
that the knife and the hands are pure,
phrases.notes: These touched the needle, yet they stay pure.

phrases.english: but the meat is impure.
phrases.notes: The needle may have been impure and passed טומאה to the meat.

phrases.english: If it was found in the stomach waste, everything is pure.
phrases.notes: פרש is not food, so it does not become impure and does not pass טומאה on to the meat.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the discussion of צירוף and degrees of טומאה in קודש, the גמרא brings a related משנה about purity in the מקדש.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Needle in the meat: the knife and hands are pure, the meat is impure. Needle in the פרש: everything is pure.

steps.title: רבי עקיבא: there is no rabbinic hand impurity in the מקדש
steps.stepSummary: רבי עקיבא learns from the needle case that the rabbinic rule of טומאת ידים does not apply in the מקדש.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי עקיבא said: We have gained the lesson that there is no impurity of hands in the מקדש.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי עקיבא draws a new rule from the משנה just quoted: since the hands stayed pure, hand impurity must not apply in the מקדש.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Normally the חכמים decreed that hands are treated as impure in certain cases. In the needle case the hands touched the needle and are still declared pure. רבי עקיבא concludes that this decree was never applied in the מקדש. The גמרא will next examine exactly what this means.

keyTerms.meaning: 'We have merited.' We have gained a new lesson.
Impurity of hands. A rabbinic rule treating hands as impure.

steps.whatToRemember: From the needle case, רבי עקיבא learns that hands are not treated as impure in the מקדש.
steps.confusionAlert: This does not mean hands can never be impure in the מקדש. רבי עקיבא's point is about the special rabbinic hand impurity. That decree simply was not applied there.
steps.whyThisMatters: This rule sets up the next stage of the סוגיא. The גמרא will probe how far it goes and how it fits with the rules about degrees of טומאה in קודש.

phrases.english: Rabbi Akiva said:
We have merited (to learn)
phrases.notes: A way of saying: we've gained a valuable new idea here.

phrases.english: that there is no impurity of hands in the Temple.
phrases.notes: Learned from the fact that the hands touching the needle stayed pure.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: רבי עקיבא draws a general rule from the ruling in the משנה that the hands stay pure.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: There is no rabbinic hand impurity in the מקדש.
